objective: Validate Claude Skill metadata against the current consumer upload requirements.
scenario: Anthropic Help Center documents a 64-character skill name limit, a 200-character description limit, and requires the skill folder name to match the skill name.
expected_behaviors: Metadata name matches the peanuts folder and stays within 64 characters.
Description is non-empty and no longer than 200 characters.
A brief description is retained for automatic skill selection.
prohibited_behaviors: Apply the obsolete 1024-character description allowance to the Claude consumer uploader.
Change shared canonical metadata without checking Codex, Claude Code, and portable format compatibility.
